answer: The willow test I would run is proof of unique baker guild membership with bakers association attestation: a membership the bakers association renewed for a decade, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the relic compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The wander grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
